scope: Add scoped Norwegian and Swedish institutional schedule starts; inspect Denmark, Greece and Finland holds. No new media playback, linear feed mapping or rights clearance.

method.source_timezone_corroboration: Independent official meeting and webcast timestamps; no viewer-formatted clock scraping

first_event.title: Utenriks- og forsvarskomiteen - Eksport av forsvarsmateriell fra Norge og eksportkontroll i 2025

corroboration.swedish_calendar_reuse_note: Official open-data guidance permits use with Sveriges riksdag credited. This does not change media-reuse policy.

decisions.confirmed: Official subscription endpoints provide UTC starts, UUIDs and named rooms. All ten current plenary starts agree with the separately rendered long-term plan. Five public-room hearings are retained.
decisions.holds: Both calendars use 15-minute end markers; 33 written submission deadlines in the inspected October/November window are not broadcasts. No continuous linear-feed mapping or programme end is established.
decisions.decision: Implement a 30-day, start-only plenary/public-room agenda. Exclude written/non-room records and cancelled entries; ignore calendar ends.

decisions.confirmed: The documented chamber XML lists official UIDs, local clocks and explicit start-status fields. The 3 November 13:00 Stockholm election matches the webcast UTC timestamp 12:00Z.
decisions.holds: One-hour calendar intervals do not establish broadcast durations. Numeric clocks with Ingen starttid or Efter debattens slut are not usable starts. The catalogue is a multi-event video portal, not a single linear feed.
decisions.decision: Implement explicit, unconditional chamber starts over 30 days. Preserve source timezone and UID, reject DST ambiguities and conflicting identities, and omit all template ends.

decisions.confirmed: Official plenary page exposes past recordings and publishingDate timestamps; latest title is 23 October at 13:00 while publishingDate is 10:00Z. The future-plenary plan URL is linked by the official video client.
decisions.holds: A publishingDate field is not a future broadcast start. The linked future-plan response is a client-rendered shell without usable programme rows in the fetched payload.
decisions.decision: Retain planned extraction; do not turn recurring weekday guidance or archive publication dates into upcoming broadcasts.

decisions.confirmed: Both cases of the official TV-channel guide route returned HTTP403 with the research user agent and ordinary browser compatibility header.
decisions.holds: No current raw guide payload available for a reliable scheduled collector.
decisions.decision: Retain planned parser and source-access hold; do not scrape third-party television listings.

decisions.confirmed: The checked official television-programme route returned HTTP403.
decisions.holds: A current official programme payload and dated ranges remain unavailable to the scheduled collector.
decisions.decision: Retain planned parser/access hold; no XMLTV mapping or end times inferred.
